doc_title_en: Notice Regarding Dividend Forecast Including Kyuden HD Commemorative Dividend
doc_title_jp: キューデンＨＤ記念配当を含む配当予想に関するお知らせ

key_facts.reason_jp: 九州電力創業75周年と純粋持株会社体制発足を記念

summary_en: Kyuden HD will pay a year-end dividend of 30 yen per share for fiscal year ending March 2027, comprising 25 yen ordinary dividend and 5 yen commemorative dividend, bringing total annual dividend to 55 yen including the 25 yen interim dividend. The commemorative dividend marks the 75th anniversary of Kyushu Electric Power and the establishment of the pure holding company structure.
summary_jp: 2027年3月期の期末配当は1株当たり30円（普通配当25円、記念配当5円）。中間配当25円と合わせた年間配当は55円。九州電力の創業75周年と純粋持株会社体制発足を記念した特別配当。
